title: 第23章 捅破天一第24章 捅破天二
lines: 第二天，天际刚刚泛白，后山上的阁楼之上，众人便是穿戴着馨儿连夜做得黑色紧身衣，集合在院子了。
萧羽缓缓扫过众人：“今日是我落日军团的第一战，不用我多说，我希望诸位能够与我齐心合力，为落日军团打出声威，彻底拿回我们失去的东西！”
众人表情肃穆！
“请旗！”萧羽一声大喝。
馨儿拿出血色的骷髅战旗，此旗一展，众人顿时生出一种热血沸腾的感觉！
“战！”萧羽接过战旗一声大喝！
二十几人，却有了千军万马的气势！
这家伙果然比我更加适合做统帅啊！赤天歌这次是真的服了。
萧羽将金色的骷髅面具交与赤天歌，弓紫嫣，蛮儿与黑子四人，另外将23面黑色的骷髅面具交予赤天歌发与剩下的人。
“出发！”众人极速的向山下，冲去，目标家族矿脉！
就在后山的阁楼的大门口，一个瘦小的身影看着一队人马列队而出！那高举战旗的身影一下子就烙进了灵魂，少年紧紧攥着拳头，迈开坚定的步伐向阁楼内走去！
同时，在山脚下许多早起的弟子震感看着眼前的一幕！血色骷髅战旗，白，金，黑的骷髅面具！一个个气势冲天，这些人是谁？
同时在山脚的路旁，两道身影面面相觑，正是张恒与肖静两人！
“真的炼成了。”张恒苦笑。
“师兄，那白色的面具，如果不是眼睛看见，根本感觉不出他的存在，而其他的面具给人感觉气息很隐晦，应该是隐藏类的功能，至于再是否有其他的功能就不知道了，你可知道是什么符文的气息？”肖静苦涩的道。
“我也不知啊！”张恒无奈道。
“血色骷髅战旗，骷髅面具？”萧海听着汇报，沉吟着，这小子是想翻天啊！好！就由着你闹，这次我倒是想看看你三大族是否敢出动地武境！
“去通知大长老，告诉他前往矿脉！另外通知二长老，家族卫队时刻准备战斗！萧海沉声道。
“是！”汇报之人立刻消失。
账房处，一位老者，浑浊的双眼消失不见，取而代之的是一双精光四射的眸子！
“嘿嘿，小子比你那，个知道单打独斗的老爹强，有了自己的势力！帝家，血家，赵家，陆家！等他成长起来，统领整个萧家的时候，当年的灭族之仇也该清算了！”老者喃喃道。
萧家的黑石矿脉。
content_en:
The next day, the sky had just turned white. On the attic on the back hill, everyone gathered in the yard wearing black tights made by Xiner overnight.
Xiao Yu slowly swept through the crowd: "Today is the first battle of my Sunset Legion. Needless to say, I hope that you all can work together with me to build a reputation for the Sunset Legion and completely get back what we have lost!"
Everyone looked solemn!
"Flag please!" Xiao Yu shouted loudly.
Xin'er took out the bloody skull battle flag. When the flag was displayed, everyone suddenly felt excited!
"Fight!" Xiao Yu took the battle flag and shouted!
"Fight!"
"Fight!"
There are more than 20 people, but they have the momentum of thousands of troops!
This guy is indeed more suitable to be a commander than me! Chi Tiange was really convinced this time.
Xiao Yu handed over the golden skull masks to Chi Tiange, Gong Ziyan, Man'er and Heizi, and handed over 23 black skull masks to Chi Tiange and the remaining people.
"Let's go!" Everyone rushed down the mountain at high speed, targeting the family's mineral veins!
Right at the gate of the attic in the back mountain, a thin figure watched a group of people march out! The figure holding the battle flag high was instantly engraved into his soul. The young man clenched his fists tightly and walked towards the attic with firm steps!
At the same time, many disciples who got up early at the foot of the mountain were shocked to see the scene in front of them! Bloody skull battle flag, white, gold, and black skull mask! Everyone is so powerful. Who are these people?
At the same time, on the roadside at the foot of the mountain, two figures looked at each other, it was Zhang Heng and Xiao Jing!
"It's really done." Zhang Heng smiled bitterly.
"Senior brother, if you don't see the white mask with your eyes, you can't feel its presence at all. The other masks give people a very vague aura, which should be a hidden function. I don't know if it has other functions. Do you know what kind of rune aura it is?" Xiao Jing said bitterly.
"I don't know either!" Zhang Heng said helplessly.
"Blood skull battle flag, skull mask?" Xiao Hai listened to the report and pondered, this kid wants to overthrow the world! good! I'll leave it up to you, this time I want to see if your three major clans dare to use the Earth Martial Realm!
"Inform the First Elder and tell him to go to the mines! Also inform the Second Elder that the family guards are always ready to fight! Xiao Hai said in a deep voice.
"Yes! "The person who reported it disappeared immediately.
At the accounting office, there was an old man. His cloudy eyes disappeared and were replaced by a pair of radiant eyes!
"Hehe, this kid is better than your dad who knows how to fight alone and has his own power! Di family, Xue family, Zhao family, Lu family! When he grows up and leads the entire Xiao family, it will be time to settle the vengeance of genocide! "The old man murmured.
The Xiao family’s black stone veins.
